title: Universe screen diagnostic-canary authorization (v0.1, diagnostic collection only)
description: One separately granted permission for one DIAGNOSTIC canary run (ADR-112). It is deliberately a separate contract from universe_screen_live_authorization@0.1.0 rather than a successor of it: that contract is closed (additionalProperties false) and carries no run-kind discriminator, so extending it would have forced the authoritative runner to change, and reusing it would have let an authorization minted for authoritative screening silently authorize diagnostic collection. The two contracts differ in their contract const, so neither runner can consume the other's authorization. Everything the live authorization binds is bound here identically - packet cohort, selection, prompt bytes, provider client contract, enablement, endpoints, model route, caps and budgets - plus four facts that make the run's nature explicit and machine-checkable: run_kind is diagnostic_canary, diagnostic_only is true, promotable is false, and output_contract names the diagnostic record contract. selection_kind is pinned to canary_100: a diagnostic run may never screen the full cohort. max_rejected_rows is a required circuit breaker - a diagnostic run measures the distribution of model-output failures, but a systematically broken prompt must not burn the whole budget proving one thing. A run authorized here produces no authoritative artifact: its outputs carry diagnostic filenames and contracts that the SCREEN_v1, classifier and authoritative screen loaders all refuse.

packet_manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact v0.5 packet manifest bytes this authorization covers. Verified at preflight against the manifest actually loaded and against the selection artifact's own binding.

prompt_template_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact committed prompts/discovery/universe_high_recall_screen.md bytes. Verified at preflight against the current committed bytes, before run-directory creation, SDK factory, ADC resolution, or any network; recorded again in the v0.2 screen manifest.

selection_kind.description: Pinned: a diagnostic run screens exactly one canary_100 selection and never the full cohort.

provider_client_contract_sha256.description: The canonical client-contract digest, recomputed at preflight from the connector's own declared contract for the authorized project and location. Must equal the enablement's value.

logical_request_cap.description: One logical request per selected packet, exactly. Pinned to the canary cohort size.

run_kind.description: The only permitted value. An authoritative screen run is authorized by a different contract entirely.

max_rejected_rows.description: Circuit breaker. When the count of rejected_output rows would exceed this bound the run hard-stops with a governed receipt, leaving the rows measured so far as retained evidence. 25 for the 100-row canary.
